description: This file defines the class 'TemplateInt', which is a PHP class extending 'TemplateRange' for handling integer field templates within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for generating HTML, populating data from POST requests, retrieving field definitions, and saving configurations related to integer fields, including auto-increment functionality.

classes.name: TemplateInt
classes.description: Represents an integer field template in SuiteCRM, handling properties like auto-increment, range validation, and HTML rendering.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Returns HTML code for editing the integer field.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates object properties from POST data, specifically handling the auto_increment property.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Retrieves the field definition array for this integer field, including validation and auto-increment settings.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the field configuration, updating auto-increment start value in the database if applicable.
